import json, struct
b = open('prices.db','rb').read()
def varint(off):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        byte=b[off+i]
        if i==8: return (v<<8)|byte, off+9
        v=(v<<7)|(byte&0x7f)
        if not byte&0x80: return v, off+i+1
hdr=0x0f33
ncells=struct.unpack('>H',b[hdr+3:hdr+5])[0]
ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',b[hdr+8+i*2:hdr+10+i*2])[0] for i in range(ncells)]
rows=[]
for p in ptrs:
    off=p
    payload,off=varint(off)
    rowid,off=varint(off)
    hdrsize,h=varint(off)
    end=off+hdrsize
    types=[]
    while h<end:
        t,h=varint(h); types.append(t)
    vals=[]; d=end
    for t in types:
        if t==0: vals.append(None)
        elif t in (1,2,3,4,5,6):
            n={1:1,2:2,3:3,4:4,5:6,6:8}[t]; vals.append(int.from_bytes(b[d:d+n],'big',signed=True)); d+=n
        elif t==7: vals.append(struct.unpack('>d',b[d:d+8])[0]); d+=8
        elif t>=13 and t%2==1:
            n=(t-13)//2; vals.append(b[d:d+n].decode('utf-8','replace')); d+=n
        else:
            n=(t-12)//2; vals.append(b[d:d+n]); d+=n
    rows.append((rowid,vals))
    print(rowid,vals)
out=[{'item':v[0],'price':v[1]} for _,v in rows if len(v)>=2 and isinstance(v[0],str) and isinstance(v[1],(int,float))]
json.dump(out,open('recovered.json','w'),indent=2)
print('wrote',len(out))
